contents: **Complete edition: the Findability Starter Pack**: 5 note templates, 6 Bases, 35 saved searches, `ripgrep` and `fzf` scripts, a `qmd` configuration and an `AGENTS.md` snippet. A small starter set, not the Obsidian Starter Kit
**Complete edition: 6 worksheets**: the 20-query test, the 30-day makeover tracker, the LATCH audit, the capture-time checklist, a search log and a resurfacing routine
**254 pages (PDF)**, plus an EPUB, 2026 edition, with free updates for the whole 2026 edition (all 1.x versions); written and checked against Obsidian 1.14
**12 chapters with exercises**: note design, vault structure, built-in search, navigation, plugins, the terminal, AI search and resurfacing
**A foreword and a chapter on how to use the book**, so you know where to start
**A FAQ with 38 questions**, merged from the whole series
**Appendix A**: the cheat sheets for built-in search, the CLI, outside search, plugins and AI search, in one place
**Appendix B**: a comparison of the tools in the book, and my search order
**One reference list** with the research and the tools mentioned
